title_cyr: Еј ти Недо море, бела Недо
title_latin: Ej ti Nedo more, bela Nedo
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Еј ди' in line 1 I read as 'Еј ти' (hey you). 'лудо' here is an address word, rendered 'my dear' (my reading).

lines.cyr: Еј ди, Недо мори, бела Недо,
lines.lat: Ej di, Nedo mori, bela Nedo,
lines.en: Hey you, Neda, hey, white Neda,
why did you get up so early, Neda?
Why did you get up so early, Neda?

lines.cyr: Чешма, ли, нема Недо во селото?
lines.lat: Češma, li, nema Nedo vo seloto?
lines.en: Is there no fountain, Neda, in the village?

lines.cyr: Има, има, лудо, как' да нема.
lines.lat: Ima, ima, ludo, kak' da nema.
lines.en: There is, there is, my dear, how could there not be.
In the village, my dear, by the square.
In the village, my dear, by the square,
cursed people, my dear, defiled it,
they splashed it with a child's blood, my dear.
